definitions.gloss: to make a mistake, to be wrong
definitions.explanation: To err or do something incorrectly.
To confuse one thing with another, to misidentify.

examples.japanese: ⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{間違|まちが}え→間違う：03036_machigau⟧た。
⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{間違|まちが}え→間違う：03036_machigau⟧て⟦しまった→〜てしまう：03102_teshimau⟧。
⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦{番号|ばんごう}→番号：02939_bangou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{間違|まちが}え→間違う：03036_machigau⟧ました。
examples.english: I got the wrong phone number.
I mistook him for someone else.
examples.notes: AをBと間違える = to mistake A for B

examples.english: The twin sisters look so alike that it's easy to mistake them. I've gotten them mixed up many times too.

examples.english: Their voices are similar, so I mistook my older sister for my younger sister on the phone.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive). No pair verb. Pattern: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{間違|まちが}える (mistake X).

ASPECT: て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates resulting state. ⟦{間違|まちが}え→間違う：03036_machigau⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ = 'has made a mistake (error persists).'

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{間違|まちが}える (take wrong road)
- ⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦{番号|ばんごう}→番号：02939_bangou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{間違|まちが}える (dial wrong number)
- A⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧B⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{間違|まちが}える (mistake A for B)
- ⟦{間違|まちが}え→間違う：03036_machigau⟧て⟦しまう→仕舞う：03064_shimau⟧ (accidentally make mistake)

Ichidan verb.

Related: ⟦{間違|まちが}い→間違い：03733_machigai⟧ (mistake, noun). Variant: ⟦{間違|まちが}う→間違う：03036_machigau⟧ (godan, similar meaning).
